label: Week 35, 2026
recap:
This week's US AI policy activity was quiet, with just one bill movement and two case updates recorded, and no federal documents logged. The only jurisdiction to see action was California, which accounted for the week's single tracked bill.

That bill, California AB2504, falls under the workforce and education theme, touching on training people to use AI, apprenticeships, curriculum, and public literacy programs. Its status changed during the week, though this does not indicate the bill has passed. Beyond this single legislative record and the two case updates, there was no other activity to report, and no other themes or jurisdictions appeared in the data this week.
